mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wf_task_add_sign WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND instance_id = #{instanceId} AND add_sign_id = #{addSignId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT signing.add_sign_id, signing.task_id, task.node_name, instance.title AS instance_title, signing.sign_type, signing.create_time FROM wf_task_add_sign signing JOIN wf_task task ON task.task_id = signing.task_id AND task.tenant_id = signing.tenant_id AND task.instance_id = signing.instance_id JOIN wf_process_instance instance ON instance.instance_id = signing.instance_id AND instance.tenant_id = signing.tenant_id AND instance.deleted = 0 WHERE signing.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND task.assignee = #{userId} AND signing.status = 'PENDING' AND instance.status IN ('RUNNING', 'WITHDRAWN', 'TASK_BACK', 'RESTARTED', 'PENDING') ORDER BY signing.create_time DESC, signing.add_sign_id
